mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, which can lead to increased costs and reduced output, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the quarters where the GDP increase condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
